result:
That confirms the pattern: `session.tsx` already calls `qrToString` with the same `type: 'utf8'` + `errorCorrectionLevel: 'L'` shape and no `small`, so this is the same causa found elsewhere in the repo, giving a good regex for the pattern's `senal_del_verificador`.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/command-runtime/src/commands/bridge/bridge.tsx",
 "edits": [{"old": "    qrToString(displayUrl, {\n      type: 'utf8',\n      errorCorrectionLevel: 'L',\n      small: true,\n    })", "new": "    qrToString(displayUrl, {\n      type: 'utf8',\n      errorCorrectionLevel: 'L',\n    })"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "terminal-only-qrcode-option-with-non-terminal-type",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS2769: No overload matches this call\\.[\\s\\S]*?'small' does not exist in type 'QRCodeToStringOptionsOther'",
               "fix_generico": "En una llamada a `qrcode`'s `toString`/`toDataURL`/`toBuffer` con `type` distinto de `'terminal'`, quitar la opción `small` del objeto de opciones: el tipo `QRCodeToStringOptionsOther` (y equivalentes) no la admite porque el renderer que la lee (`lib/renderer/terminal.js`) sólo se invoca cuando `type: 'terminal'`; para cualquier otro `type` la clave es ignorada en tiempo de ejecución, así que retirarla no cambia la conducta.",
               "edits": [0]}],
 "fixes": ["src/packages/command-runtime/src/commands/bridge/bridge.tsx(152,5): error TS2769: No overload matches this call."],
 "skipped": []}
```
